description: Meal Explorer is a React app that fetches meal data from an external API. The Menu page displays the first 5 meals, with a search bar that fetches matching meals as the user types. The Home page includes navigation, a banner, general info, top 3 meals, a MORE button to load additional meals, and contact details.
